[Example — verify with merchant:]

Welcome to Holiday Inn Grand Rapids South by IHG, your family's gateway to Michigan fun and comfort. Located just 15 minutes from downtown Grand Rapids, our hotel combines the trusted quality of the Holiday Inn brand with amenities designed for families traveling with kids.

Our indoor splash pad is the star attraction — a year-round water play area featuring fountains, sprayers, and shallow wading zones perfect for toddlers through age 10. Open daily from 8 AM to 9 PM, the splash pad provides hours of entertainment regardless of Michigan weather.

Rooms feature your choice of two queen beds or one king, accommodating families of up to 4 guests comfortably. Every room includes mini-fridge, microwave, flat-screen TV, and work desk. Start each day with our complimentary hot breakfast buffet featuring eggs, waffles, fresh fruit, and kid-friendly cereals.

You're minutes from Frederik Meijer Gardens & Sculpture Park (4 miles), John Ball Zoo (6 miles), downtown Grand Rapids dining and breweries (7 miles), and major business parks. Free parking and WiFi throughout your stay.
